criteria.name: Mission concept and rationale — What will it do, who are the users, why is it needed?
criteria.reasoning: Clear goal plus four quantified objectives linked to named Australian users and needs with literature support. Objectives drive later design. Fully meets Accomplished descriptor.

evidence.quote: Give reef managers direct, repeatable observations of coral colour over the whole Great Barrier Reef
The satellite would be operated by the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS).

criteria.name: Project plan — How you plan to complete the assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable and information sources you plan to use
criteria.reasoning: Gantt Weeks 2-10 with tasks, order justified by mission dependencies, explicit risks/triggers/responses and float, plus sourced Table 2. Robust, mission-linked, with contingencies.

evidence.quote: The design will be completed in STK (Systems Tool Kit), accessed remotely through the MECH lab 204 licence.
Week 10 is float as well as editing time: no new design work is planned in it.

criteria.name: Preliminary progress — Technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date
criteria.reasoning: Correct 600 km SSO hand calculations for period, inclination, ground-track shift and swath with interpretation identifying coverage-resolution trade and next steps. Clearly on track.

evidence.quote: Weekly coverage (objective 1) is therefore not guaranteed by one satellite at this altitude and resolution.
A first STK scenario with this orbit has been set up, and its period agrees with the hand calculation.

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Logical headings, clear writing, consistent tables and labelled Gantt, in-text citations [1]-[11] matching reference list. Minor gold/yellow wording difference only.

evidence.quote: Figure 1: Project Gantt chart, Weeks 2 to 10 (gold = completed, blue = planned, red lines = report deadlines).

technical_issues.issue: 60 km swath assumes 10 m x 6000 pixels without stated sensor source; acceptable as preliminary assumption but needs justification.

overall: Strong Australia-benefit reef-monitoring concept with quantified objectives, robust contingency-based plan, correct preliminary SSO analysis informing design trades, and professional presentation.

feedback.summary: Well done — you presented a strong Great Barrier Reef monitoring concept with quantified objectives for AIMS, a robust contingency-based plan to Week 10, correct 600 km SSO calculations, and professional presentation. You are clearly on track to guide your full mission design.
next_steps: Justify your 60 km swath assumption in Preliminary Progress with a sensor source for 10 m x 6000 pixels.
Use your finding that weekly coverage is not guaranteed to trade altitude, swath and constellation size in STK.
Keep your Weeks 2-10 Gantt logic with Week 10 float and Table 2 sources updated as STK validation progresses.

criteria.C1: You did well in Mission Concept & Rationale to set a clear goal to give reef managers direct repeatable coral-colour observations for the whole Great Barrier Reef, with four quantified objectives for AIMS and literature support. To reach full Accomplished marks, keep objectives driving your later requirements and design choices.
criteria.C2: You built a robust Weeks 2-10 Gantt in Project Plan with Figure 1, justified task order by mission dependencies, specified STK via MECH lab 204 licence, Table 2 sources and Week 10 float with risks/triggers/responses. To secure top Accomplished, keep plan and contingencies updated to match design progress.
criteria.C3: You calculated 600 km SSO period, inclination, ground-track shift and swath correctly in Preliminary Progress and interpreted that weekly coverage is not guaranteed, with STK period agreeing. For full Accomplished, justify your 60 km swath 10 m x 6000-pixel assumption with a sensor source and resolve the coverage-resolution trade.
criteria.C4: You presented professionally with logical headings, clear writing, consistent tables and labelled Figure 1 Gantt, with in-text [1]-[11] matching your reference list. To hold high Accomplished, keep formatting, figure/table labels and citation accuracy consistent in the full report.
